milestone: M848/C2 R23 regular-file whitelist result publication

p0.finding: The runner passes all 15 recursive whitelist members plus both seals to the inherited verify-sealed-directory --exact-root-members interface. That verifier explicitly rejects every exact member containing '/'. Ten required members are nested under attack/ or equalbw/, so the formal runner deterministically fails after sealing the result stage.
p0.independent_reproduction: After stage_result_whitelist and base.seal_directory on a complete synthetic work tree, base.verify_sealed_directory(stage, exact_recursive_members) fails with: flat root contains nested member.
p0.impact: If released, the one formal M848 attempt would be consumed and would fail again in RESULT_STAGE_SEAL despite both VCS simulations succeeding. No canonical result could be published.
p0.required_repair: Add an R23-specific recursive exact-population verifier and no-replace publisher, or otherwise verify the sealed recursive population without invoking the frozen flat-root assertion. Exercise the full stage -> seal -> exact verify -> collision-safe publish -> post-publish verify path in tests. Refresh every changed SHA and obtain a new independent source hammer before authoring a release. Do not weaken O_NOFOLLOW or exact member equality.

positive_findings.publication_copy: The new stage_result_whitelist implementation uses O_NOFOLLOW for every path component and file, requires regular files, creates destinations with O_EXCL, and checks source device/inode/size/SHA before and after copying.
positive_findings.whitelist_population: The isolated whitelist stage contains exactly 15 regular nonsymlink files; tool-generated symlinks and unlisted files remain in private VCS work.
positive_findings.frozen_hardware_and_tests: M803 RTL, SVA, both TBs and all three filelists match the SHA map. The attack/equal-bandwidth command and PASS-gate block is byte-identical to M837 R22 with SHA256 261d47f0a57fd76176c63961b472d353f7e294e9b40a05a8571bed475005ef14.
positive_findings.spent_predecessor: The sealed M846 failure hammer and the consumed M837 attempt are bound and are not reused or salvaged.
positive_findings.one_attempt_and_no_clobber: The formal M848 result/attempt identities are absent. Shell prechecks and renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE) retain fail-closed collision behavior.
positive_findings.source_boundary: Source dry-run stops with rc 86 before license/VCS and reports zero license queries, compile runs, simv runs, attempts, results and quarantines.

python36_author_tests.coverage_gap: The author tests stop after whitelist staging and do not exercise seal plus recursive exact verification or publication.
